column4: The home is the locked picture. Squatch is a brown furry kid and Mops is a white goat whose beard hangs like a mop. No separate mop.
Sneaky Sasquatch is named only as the inspiration. The rooms, people and song are this game's.
The hall is one still locked picture filling the screen.
The title glows. The first tap starts an original tune.
Mops's morning lines show one at a time, on him.
SING lights up, they sing, and Mops leaves.
The evening card shows, then the hall sneak.
He walks to the outlined plant and HIDE lights up.
A dashed cone fills, he hops, and the lockup card shows. The sneak then starts again.
The next tap glows: the title, each line, SING, and HIDE.
Each person who can see has a dashed cone.
The player taps the floor to walk. Nothing walks him to the plant.
Being seen hops him, shows the lockup card, and restarts that sneak.
Joe's song and the goodbye are original notes, not a known tune.
The title box glows.
The first tap sets the song to Joe's tune and opens the morning.
The card says who Squatch is.
Mops says good morning, the party, and stay in here.
Each line stays until a tap.
SING is lit.
They sing, Mops is gone, and the evening card is up.
Squatch starts on the hall floor, left of the plant.
The plant's own shape is outlined.
The playthrough walks him there with floor taps.
The yellow guest's cone sweeps between the stage and the floor.
Standing in the cone shows the lockup card, then he is back at the start of the sneak.
His eyes sit low in the front leaves.
Later chapters are not in this build.
